description.value: Ace Brewing Company is a family-owned microbrewery and taproom in Courtenay's Comox Valley, themed around the ace fighter pilots of WWI and WWII who flew from nearby CFB Comox. The Landolt family built the brewery around a commitment to quality, producing everything from crisp German-style Pilsners to bold West Coast IPAs. The taproom pours a rotating lineup of craft beers that includes the 2022 Canada Beer Cup Silver Medal-winning Wingman Pale Ale.
